policies.name: yorp_sample_seed_assets_read
policies.using: ((bucket_id = 'registration-seed-file'::text) AND (name = ANY (ARRAY['Constitution and By-Laws.pdf'::text, 'Endorsement.pdf'::text, 'NYC YORP Registration Form (Form B).pdf'::text, 'Pasig City YORP Registration Form (Form A).pdf'::text, 'YORP Directory of Officers and Adviser.pdf'::text, 'YORP List of Members in Good Standing.pdf'::text])))

policies.name: ytrace_private_organization_delete
policies.using: ((bucket_id = ANY (ARRAY['organization-documents'::text, 'budget-request-files'::text, 'liquidation-report-files'::text, 'ypop-files'::text, 'move-files'::text])) AND (COALESCE(owner_id, (owner)::text) = (( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid))::text) AND ytrace_storage_private.organization_object_access(bucket_id, name, 'delete'::text))
